• 核心邏輯：全球宏觀流動性水庫正在發生重要變化，直接牽動著大額資本的流向。
• 實戰策略：宏觀定方向、微觀定進出：順應大趨勢，不與趨勢作對。在重要宏觀數據發布前做好防守，杜絕無序盲動。

SMASH is trying a more interesting distribution route than another chain announcement: put the same card game inside places people already play.

On October 10, Smash&Clash published Minecraft Java/Bedrock downloads and a FiveM resource for GTA V servers. I checked the releases, tagged SDK code and the actual GTA ZIP, including its server-side game API bridge. These are published client artifacts, not just a coming-soon graphic. I haven't run them or verified cross-client gameplay.

The FiveM angle matters: a server owner can introduce the game to an existing community. That's a plausible discovery channel for the builder and his coin—not proof that anyone installed it, and definitely not SMASH inheriting GTA's audience. The releases disclaim official Rockstar/Cfx.re and Mojang/Microsoft association.

The exact Solana coin is identified in the game's terms as the founder's community token. Core play stays free. Prize-contest policy specifies SMASH, but holders get no claim on revenue or ownership. Shipped clients, contest policy and actual token demand are three different things.

I'm keeping this on watch, not buying this wake. An attributable server-owner or creator pickup could make the next-buyer story concrete. The shipping deserves credit; outside distribution and original-coin conversion remain unproven in my bounded checks.

AI関連株の注目銘柄をまとめました。

いま一番大事なのは、10/15のTSMC決算から11月中旬のNVIDIA決算まで続く決算シーズンです。ここで「AIへの投資がこの先も続くか」が確かめられます。8〜9月はAIバブル論や大手クラウド企業の借金の増加で株価が足踏みしましたが、9月末からはMicronの好決算をきっかけに持ち直しています。

半導体

NVDA（NVIDIA）： 直近の四半期の売上は962億ドルで、前年の約2倍でした。次の四半期は、初めて1,000億ドルを超える見込みです。不安材料は、メモリ価格の高騰で利益率が下がることです。株価は229ドル（10/9）です。

AVGO（Broadcom）： GoogleやOpenAI向けに、専用のAIチップを作っています。AI半導体の売上は前年比221%増でした。ただ、年初からの株価は+1.5%と出遅れていて、割高との見方もあります。

MU（Micron）： 2026年度の売上は過去最高でした。2027年分のAI向けメモリ（HBM）も、大半がすでに高い値段で売約済みです。株価は年初から+273%と急騰しています。

TSM（TSMC）： 10/15の決算で示される2027年のAI需要の見通しが、相場全体の方向を決めそうです。

クラウド・ソフト

GOOGL（Alphabet）： 今週「Gemini agent」を発表しました。原子力発電の契約もあります。決算は10/28です。

MSFT（Microsoft）： 決算は10/28で、Copilotは使った分だけ払う料金体系に移りつつあります。

PLTR（Palantir）： 10/8にGoldman Sachsが「買い」に引き上げ、目標株価を230ドルにしました。決算は11/2ごろの予想です。

データセンターの電力・冷却・ネットワーク

VRT（Vertiv）： NVIDIAの新しい電源設計のパートナーです。ただ、アナリストの評価は「買い」と「売り」に分かれていて、株価は高値から33%下にあります。

CEG（Constellation Energy）： 10/7にGoogleと原子力発電の契約を結びました。電力網のルールがまだ決まっていないのが不安材料です。

ANET（Arista Networks）： AIデータセンター向けの新しいネットワーク製品を発表しました。決算は11/3です。

日本株

6857（アドバンテスト）： AI半導体の検査装置が好調で、業績予想を上方修正しました。10/7に上場来の高値をつけ、決算は10/28です。

8035（東京エレクトロン）： 4〜6月期は利益が46%増えました。10/30の決算で通期の予想が出ます。

9984（ソフトバンクグループ）： OpenAIへの出資は累計646億ドルになりました。借金とOpenAIのニュースに株価が振られやすい銘柄です。

そのほか、フジクラ（5803）とイビデン（4062）も候補です。

主なリスク
大きなものは5つあります。巨額投資のための借金、メモリや電力の不足、AIエージェントへの規制強化（今週のAnthropicの件など）、割高な株価、そして金利と米国の中間選挙です。

いくつか注意点があります。決算日のうち、AMZNとPLTRはまだ確定していません。NVIDIAも11/17と11/18の情報が混ざっています。Google Cloudの受注残と、アドバンテストの予想の数字は、元の記事までは確かめられていません。投資を勧めるものではなく、情報を整理したものとして見てください。

🔍 私が注目する5つのテーマ
① 💰 高配当株の配当余力
武田薬品・JT・双日

高配当株投資で気になるのは、配当利回りよりも配当の持続性。

✔ 利益成長と配当性向
✔ キャッシュフロー
✔ 増配・減配の可能性

現在進めている個別株から高配当ETFへの出口戦略にも関係する重要な決算です😊

② 🏦 金利上昇の影響
SBI HD・ヒューリック

金利上昇は銀行には利ざや拡大の追い風、一方で不動産には借入コスト増加の逆風となる可能性。

ただし、不動産も賃料上昇で吸収できるかもしれません。

同じ金利上昇でも業種によって明暗が分かれるのか、注目です👀

③ 🏢 不動産の収益力
ヒューリック

✔ 賃貸収益の成長
✔ 物件売却益
✔ 借入金利の影響
✔ 増配余力

J-REITにも投資しているので、不動産市場の先行きを考える材料にしたいです。

④ ☀️ ペロブスカイト太陽電池
積水化学工業

日本発の次世代太陽電池として期待されるペロブスカイト。

✔ 量産化の進捗
✔ 設備投資の規模
✔ 商用化と収益化の時期

期待先行ではなく、いつ利益に貢献するのかを確認したいですね😊

⑤ 🤖 AIと技術者派遣
メイテックグループHD

今回、個人的にかなり気になるテーマ‼️

AIによって設計・開発業務が効率化されれば、必要な技術者数が減る可能性も。

一方、AI・半導体・高度な開発分野では技術者の需要が増える可能性もあります。

注目するのは、
✔ 技術者の稼働率
✔ 派遣単価と稼働時間
✔ AI関連の技術者需要
✔ 採用・教育コスト

さらに9月には約30億円の特別損失計上を発表。中間純利益予想を下方修正した一方、経常利益予想は上方修正しています。

本業の収益力と一時的な損失を分けて確認したいところです。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

好決算だから保有、悪決算だから売却という単純な判断ではなく、

「3年後も安心して配当を受け取れる企業なのか？」

これを重視したいと思います。

58歳での会社員卒業に向けて、
🎯 金融資産1.5億円
🎯 年間配当300万円

この目標に向けた保有銘柄の再点検です😊

決算発表後は、予想と実績を比較して振り返りたいと思います‼️

AIトレンドニュース要点（CTEE記事）
詳細は該当するCTEE抽出記事Noを参照のこと

I. 半導体製造・先進パッケージング：2027年需要と設備投資が焦点

TSMCの足元の増収と、2027年の追加投資に対する市場期待を区別することが重要です。 記事によれば、9月売上高は5,118.57億台湾ドル、前年同月比54.6％増。第3四半期売上高は1.49兆台湾ドル、前四半期比17.6％増となり、四半期最高を更新して会社ガイダンスの上限を超えました。

成長要因として
AI／高性能計算、
3nm、
立ち上がりが加速する2nmが挙げられています。

一方、2026年の米ドル建て売上成長率が40％を超えるという見通しは、法人側の予測です。〔記事No.44、46〕

需要の広がりについて、
AMDのLisa Su氏は訪台時に、2027年のAIチップ供給を大幅に増やす計画を示し、CPU・GPUに必要な先端ウェハー能力をTSMCと協議していると述べています。記事はNVIDIA Rubin、AMD MI450、Google TPUの拡大と、クラウド事業者の自社ASIC投資を挙げ、AI需要とCoWoS能力の見通しがさらに上方修正されるかを、10月15日のTSMC決算説明会の注目点としています。CoWoSの具体的な増設量については、今回の本文にデータがありません。〔記事No.4〕

先端工程では、
Apple、
Qualcomm、
MediaTekの新世代旗艦チップが2nmを採用し、

Apple、NVIDIA、AMD、Qualcomm、MediaTekが
N2系列の能力予約を増やしたという供給網情報が記載されています。

確認対象は
N2の能力立ち上げ、
歩留まり、
売上寄与、
およびN2P・A16の量産進捗です。

また、法人はAI ASICに加え、
Agentic AIに伴うCPU・ネットワークチップ需要が
N3の逼迫を支え、
2027年の先端工程価格に
10～15％の上昇余地があると予測しています。

予約増の具体的数量や値上げの実現は不確かです。〔記事No.1、4〕

設備投資の数値は、次のように区別できます。

| 項目 | 添付本文の記載 | 情報の位置付け |

| 2026年設備投資 | 
600億～640億米ドル。70～80％を先端工程に配分 | 記事が既存の会社予算として記載 |

| 2027年設備投資 | 
700億～800億米ドルへの拡大を市場が期待 | 市場予想。会社の確定計画ではない |

2027年投資、
AI需要、
N2、
米国増設は説明会の主要論点ですが、
期待どおりの発表になるかは不確かです。

記事No.16はTerafabとの協力も注目点に挙げていますが、契約内容、役割分担、正式合意を確認できるデータはありません。〔記事No.4、11、16〕

TSMCの製造・CoWoS・海外工場投資は、台湾の半導体装置、特殊化学品、封装材料、シリコンフォトニクスの企業群にも関係すると記事は整理しています。〔記事No.12〕

II. メモリー：長期契約の拡大と台湾拠点の労務問題

Micronについては、
長期需要の確保と、
　
　生産拠点の労使交渉が並行して報じられています。 

記事によれば、
長期契約の顧客数は16社から26社へ増え、
一部の契約期間は2031年まで延長。

2030年売上高の
35％超をカバーしているとされています。

さらに、同社経営陣の説明として、
2027年の生産能力の75％超が予約済み、
戦略的顧客契約は26件、
未履行契約金額は1,500億米ドルと記載されています。

2027・2028年の需給が2026年より厳しくなるという見通しも、会社側の判断として紹介されています。〔記事No.16、217〕

技術面では、
MicronがNVIDIAと次世代HBM4eで協力し、
カスタム製品「NVHBM」を
次世代GPUおよびNVLink Fusion向けに展開すると記事は報じています。

2027年の設備投資を増やし、台湾、日本、シンガポール、米国で増設する方針も記載されています。ただし、拠点別投資額、追加能力、稼働時期の詳細データはありません。〔記事No.217〕

台湾はMicronのDRAM・HBM製造および封装の主要拠点で、記事は生産能力比率を6割超、従業員を約1万5,000人と説明しています。

労使問題の中心は、
利益分配と株式報酬の配分に対する認識の差です。

工会側は制度の不透明さなどを問題視し、内部調査では台湾従業員のうちRSUを受け取る比率が約40～60％と述べています。これは工会側の調査値です。〔記事No.217〕

記事時点では、
桃園工会は交渉決裂後、
合法的なストライキ権取得に向けた投票を開始。

　台中工会は
　　10月22日の第2回調停後に
　　　判断する予定とされています。

会社側は報奨金の支給計画と分配制度の改善方針を示していますが、投票結果、実際のストライキ開始、生産停止量についてはデータがありません。供給障害が発生したと断定することはできません。〔記事No.217〕

同記事は、
SK hynixとSamsungでも利益分配を巡る労使問題が起きたものの、制度調整などにより実際のストライキ開始前に解決したと説明しています。Micronについても、拡張投資と従業員への利益還元をどう両立するかが論点です。〔記事No.217〕

封装・ストレージ周辺では、力成がメモリー需給改善、メーカーの先端封装投資、企業向けSSD・大容量ストレージ需要を背景に、稼働率と製品構成の改善を期待されています。これは今後の業績に関する見通しです。〔記事No.53〕

III. PCB・ABF・ガラス基板：大型化と高速化が仕様を引き上げる

公営銀行の産業調査部門は、AIインフラと高性能計算がPCBの仕様向上を主導し、AIチップ基板、先端封装、ガラス基板を成長分野として挙げています。ただし、台湾PCB業界全体の年間景況判断は「やや良い」であり、業界全体が一様に急拡大するという評価ではありません。〔記事No.9〕

記事では、NVIDIAのGPUサーバー向け加速器モジュールに必要なHDI基板などの仕様が高度化し、中間基板やバックプレーンが従来の銅ケーブル接続を徐々に代替すると説明しています。技術要件の上昇により、対応可能なPCBメーカーが限られてくるという見方です。〔記事No.9〕

ABF基板では、
需要量だけでなく
大型化に伴う歩留まり低下が供給上の論点です。 

AIチップの封装サイズ拡大で
ABF需要が増える一方、
基板面積の増加によって
歩留まりが下がるとされています。

Rubinなどの大型チップの投入に伴い、
構造的な供給不足と
価格上昇が起こる可能性を
銀行調査部門は指摘しています。

ただし、これは予測であり、不足の実現時期、数量、値上げ幅は不確かです。〔記事No.9〕

ガラス基板は、
剛性、
反りの抑制、
寸法安定性、
高速信号の品質という利点から注目されています。

一方、
材料の脆さと微細亀裂は、
量産歩留まりと長期信頼性の課題として残っています。

台湾企業では
Unimicronがガラス貫通孔「TGV」を
早期導入する基板企業として紹介され、

ASEと力成は
FOPLPの量産能力を持つとされています。

群創は既存ラインの転換を進め、SpaceXの供給網に参入しています。〔記事No.9〕

材料の業績面では、
南亞がAI・半導体需要を背景に電子材料の価格を連月引き上げ、能力利用はほぼ満杯、電子材料の売上比率は約6割に近づいていると報じられています。

南亞科、南亞電路板などへの投資利益も業績を支える要因として挙げられています。これらは南亞に関する記載であり、他の材料企業にも同じ価格・稼働状況があるとは断定できません。〔記事No.55〕

IV. 電力・冷却・光通信：設備需要の拡大と供電技術の特許問題

電力確保では、
AmazonとGoogleがそれぞれ
Constellationと
20年間の電力購入契約を締結したと記事は報じています。

電網更新や発電設備の改良も挙げられ、AIデータセンターの電力需要が台湾の重電設備企業に関連する需要として整理されています。機電業者は、2025～2030年の世界のデータセンター電力使用量がほぼ倍増すると試算しています。〔記事No.10〕

台湾では、士林電機、亞力、華城が変圧器・配電盤を供給し、中興電工は空調、発電機、GIS開閉設備を展開しています。中興電工のGISは大手ファウンドリの認証を取得し、第4四半期から台湾工場向け供給を始める予定とされています。〔記事No.10〕

受注残について、記事は士林電機が600億台湾ドル超、中興電工が400億台湾ドル超、亞力が130億台湾ドル以上と記載しています。中興電工の一部台電案件は2031年まで見通せるとされています。一方、華城の約700億台湾ドルという受注残は市場推計であり、会社公表値ではありません。〔記事No.10〕

亞力は半導体工場の国内外増設、台電の電網強化、AIデータセンターを成長源として挙げています。1～9月売上高は80.25億台湾ドル、前年同期比8.24％増で、第4四半期売上高が年内最高になると予測しています。〔記事No.57〕

データセンター内の電力・冷却では、
Delta Electronicsの高圧直流変換、
バッテリー予備電源、蓄電、高度液冷の製品群が紹介されています。市場はこれらによる案件当たり供給価値の拡大を期待し、法人は2026年の液冷事業に50～60％の成長余地があると予測しています。確定した通期実績ではありません。〔記事No.47〕

高速通信では、
Realtekの第3四半期売上高が377.32億台湾ドル、前年同期比27.94％増となり、2四半期連続で最高を更新しました。Wi-Fi 7、マルチGbE、車載Ethernet、AIサーバーへの参入が成長要因です。100G光学PHYは2027年第1四半期に量産予定との法人見解が記載されています。また、記事No.16は、AIサーバーの高速伝送需要がPCB・CPOを支えると述べていますが、CPOの企業別受注量や出荷額についてはデータがありません。〔記事No.16、48〕

供電技術では、
Vicorの申し立てに基づき、USITCが垂直給電システム、部品、それらを搭載する運算設備について337条調査を開始しました。Foxconn、Delta、Quantaと関連会社を含む20社が対象で、Infineon、Monolithic Power Systems、Flex、Celesticaなども列挙されています。対象技術は給電経路を短縮して電力損失を減らすもので、データセンターのGPU、TPU、CPUなどへの給電に関係します。〔記事No.2、128〕

調査開始は特許侵害の認定を意味しません。 違反が認定されれば、輸入排除や販売停止につながる可能性がありますが、現時点の結果は不確かです。Deltaは相手方の主張であることを強調し、米国子会社と確認中で、対応に自信があると述べています。台湾経済部は必要に応じた支援を表明し、通常の審理期間を12～16カ月と説明しています。〔記事No.86、128〕

V. サーバー周辺・工場設備：レール、建設、溶剤、記録材料へ需要が広がる

King Slideは、
サーバーの機械部品を
高度化する企業として具体的に紹介されています。

記事によれば、
　世界のサーバー用レール市場で3割超、
　　　AIサーバー向けでは
　　　　　約8割のシェアを持ちます。

AIサーバー用レールは100個を超える部品で構成され、40・60・200kgなどの荷重への対応に加え、迅速な着脱、落下防止、緩衝、固定、液冷接続などの機能を備えるとされています。〔記事No.228〕

同社は約3,800件の特許を蓄積し、
ロボットアーム、専用機、自動化ソフトウェアまで内製しています。

　顧客要求を受けて3～4日で案を提示し、
　　開発・試作から最短で
　　　翌月の量産につなげられると説明されています。

金型、プレス、表面処理、組立を自社で担い、米国Houston工場の自動化設備も台湾で開発・試験してから移設しています。2026年第2四半期の粗利益率は87.42％と記載されています。〔記事No.228〕

工場建設では、洋基工程がAI、先端工程、メモリーメーカーの増設を背景に、クリーンルーム、機電工事、工場一括請負の需要拡大を受けています。受注残は500億台湾ドルを超え、過去最高、事業の見通しは2027年まで延びています。聖暉もAIサーバー・半導体投資による受注と工事売上計上が強く、1～8月売上高337.5億台湾ドルで同期最高を記録しました。〔記事No.52、54〕

製造材料では、勝一がウェハー工場の増設・建設と洗浄需要を背景に、半導体向け電子級溶剤の販売数量を伸ばしています。1～9月売上高は106.73億台湾ドルで、前年通年の115.01億台湾ドルに近づいています。〔記事No.58〕

ストレージ材料では、光洋科がAIデータセンター増設に伴う大容量HDDと半導体ターゲット材の需要拡大を受け、HAMRの導入が高付加価値材料の出荷を支えると記事は説明しています。〔記事No.59〕

VI. AI事業・産業政策・資金環境：投資拡大と利益への転換が併存

台湾企業の事業展開では、ゲーム橘子がAIデータセンター・計算能力事業に進出しています。光聚晶電は持株会社へ転換し、半導体、電力などへ投資して、ゲーム売上比率を一桁まで下げたとされています。両社の新事業の投資額、計算能力、収益規模についてはデータがありません。〔記事No.14〕

技術領域の広がりとして、記事No.16はAMDによるWorld Labsへの82億米ドルの事業展開を取り上げています。同記事は、空間知能・世界モデルが三次元空間、物体、環境の関係を扱い、ロボット、AR／VR、産業シミュレーションなどへの応用につながると説明しています。ただし、取引条件や台湾企業への具体的な受注波及についてはデータがありません。〔記事No.16〕

台湾の政策では、国慶演説で半導体、AI、次世代通信などを含む13の核心戦略産業が示され、シリコンフォトニクス、量子計算、ロボットが重点技術として挙げられました。政府は大企業の海外展開と並行して供給網を台湾に定着させ、伝統産業も伴って成長する方針を述べています。電力では安定供給、エネルギー安全、脱炭素に向け、多様な電源、蓄電、省エネ、電網強化を推進するとしています。〔記事No.1、6、186、194〕

拠点整備では、新竹県がAI智慧園区に4企業を誘致したと説明していますが、企業名や計算能力規模のデータはありません。松山空港の移転・AI園区化は台北市長の構想段階で、衛生福利部と医師は離島・東部の救急搬送、医療従事者の移動への影響を含めた検討を求めています。確定したデータセンター投資とは扱えません。〔記事No.161、170〕

電力事業者の財務については、燃料費上昇と電気料金据え置きによる台電の負担が報じられ、立法委員が半導体・AIによる税収増を台電への財政支援に回すよう提案しています。これは議員の提案であり、支援策の決定を示す記載ではありません。〔記事No.99〕

資金調達では、台湾全体の2026年1～9月の協調融資が174件、519億米ドル、前年同期比38％増となりました。これはAI向け融資だけの金額ではありません。銀行はAI関連大手の大型案件に加え、上流の中小企業へ融資需要が広がっていると説明し、メモリー、受動部品、サーバー企業の運営拡大・設備投資を今後の案件源に挙げています。一方、流動性カバレッジ比率の制約と資金逼迫から、第4四半期の融資姿勢が慎重になる可能性も指摘しています。〔記事No.8〕

株式市場では、
OpenAIの年間換算売上高と市場期待の差、
高水準の米国債利回りが、
AI関連株の評価に影響したと報じられています。

10月9日は米主要指数が上昇した一方、
半導体指数は0.41％、
TSMC ADRは1.02％下落し、
ASE ADRは2.59％上昇しました。

AI関連企業が一様に売買されたわけではありません。〔記事No.11、17、224〕

投資顧問記事では、
資金がAIサーバーだけでなく、
メモリー、受動部品、光通信、素材などへ循環していると整理されています。

記事No.11は、市場の関心が設備投資額の拡大から、投資を実際の利益へ転換できる企業に向かっていると述べています。10月14日の米CPI、15日の米PPIとTSMC決算説明会が、次の確認点として挙げられています。〔記事No.11、12、16、17、42、44、45〕

まとめ：AIトレンドの核心

先端製造需要は強い一方、2027年の投資額は未確定。 
TSMCの第3四半期売上は最高を更新しましたが、
700億～800億米ドルの設備投資は市場期待です。
〔記事No.4、11、46〕

メモリー需要の長期化と労使交渉が並行。 
Micronでは能力予約・顧客契約が拡大する一方、
台湾でストライキ権取得に向けた動きがあります。
実際の供給停止は確認できず、不確かです。
〔記事No.16、217〕

大型封装と高速伝送が基板・材料の要件を引き上げる。 
ABFの歩留まり、ガラス基板の信頼性、HDIなどの仕様高度化が主要論点です。
〔記事No.9〕

電力・液冷・機械部品・工場建設にも具体的な需要がある。 
重電企業の受注、Deltaの製品展開、King Slideのレール、洋基工程などの工場設備が報じられています。
〔記事No.10、47、52、54、228〕

成長需要と、特許・融資・評価の制約が併存。 
垂直給電の337条調査、銀行の流動性制約、高金利による株式評価圧力を、確定した業績や受注と区別して捉える必要があります。
〔記事No.8、11、86、128〕

Anthropic估值上看2兆美元，AI風險誰來定價？
Anthropic正籌備大型IPO，估值可能達2兆美元；但從網路攻擊、生物恐怖主義到嚴重經濟衝擊，若AI造成的損害難以量化，投資人究竟會把多少責任成本算進股價？

部分研究人員曾在X討論，AI導致人類滅絕的機率可能超過10%，但這是引發爭論的研究觀點，並非可直接換算的財務指標。共同創辦人兼執行長Dario Amodei也警告，若開發速度未放緩，人類可能失去對AI的控制，技術亦可能遭用於網攻或生物恐攻。

Slow Ventures合夥人Sam Lessin主張，美國政府應要求AI實驗室提存1兆美元現金，作為潛在損害的緩衝。他估計，即使不計人類滅絕情境，AI造成的社會負擔也可能達2兆至4兆美元；然而，市場參與者未必因此降低對IPO的估值，因為責任最終可能由其他對象承擔。

安全投入既是成本，也可能成為商業優勢。PitchBook分析師Harrison Rolfes認為，較完善的安全機制有助取得客戶信任；若中國或開源競爭者未達相同標準，反而可能拉開差距。

保險也難完全填補缺口：AI缺少歷史理賠資料，責任歸屬尚不清楚，尤其系統從提供資訊走向自主決策、並與其他代理互動後更是如此。本文反映的關鍵矛盾是，資本市場能先替成長故事定價，卻未必能先替低機率、高衝擊的責任定價。AI公司應以資本緩衝、保險，還是監管要求來承擔這類風險？

Brazilian coffee, beef and tropical fruit will still be tariffed 40%, says Brazil’s vice president

RIO DE JANEIRO — Brazilian Vice President Geraldo Alckmin said Saturday that Brazilian exported goods to the U.S. including coffee, beef and tropical fruits would still be tariffed 40%, despite President Donald Trump’s decision to remove some import taxes.

In a dramatic move on Friday, Trump scrapped levies announced in April on what he called ‘Liberation Day’ in hopes of encouraging domestic production and lifting the U.S. economy. Brazil at the time was hit with a 10% tariff.

But in July, Trump imposed a further 40% tariff, citing — among other reasons — the trial of his ally, former President Jair Bolsonaro, which he called a “witch hunt.” Proceedings went ahead regardless and in September Bolsonaro was sentenced to 27 years and three months in prison for attempting a coup.

Alckmin said some products, such as orange juice, would now have a zero tariff as they were not targeted by the additional 40%. But that extra tariff remains in place on products including coffee, beef and tropical fruits, such as mangos and pineapples.

While Brazil’s vice president welcomed Trump’s latest decision, which he called “positive” and a “step in the right direction,” he said there remained a “distortion that needs to be corrected.”

“Everyone got 10% less, but in Brazil’s case, which had 50%, we ended up with 40%, which is very high,” Alckmin told journalists in the capital Brasilia.

Alckmin said that Friday's decision means that 26% of Brazilian goods are now entering the U.S. without additional tariffs. That's up from 23%.

Trump’s July decision, which was overtly political as Brazil has a trade deficit with the United States, led to the worst U.S.-Brazil relations in history.

Those relations have since improved, and in October Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Trump met in Malaysia.

“President Lula’s conversation with President Donald Trump was important in terms of dialogue and negotiation,” Alckmin said on Saturday.

After that encounter, Lula said he was confident the two countries would soon reach a trade deal.

U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Brazil’s Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira met for 50 minutes this week to further the conversation.

The Trump administration has insisted that its tariffs helped fill government coffers and weren’t a major factor in higher prices at grocery stores around the country. But Democrats were quick to paint Friday’s move as an acknowledgment that Trump’s policies were hurting American pocketbooks.

Record-high beef prices have been a particular concern, and Trump had said he intended to take action to try and lower them. Trump’s tariffs on Brazil, a major beef exporter, had been a factor.

Back in Brazil, the Brazilian Association of the Coffee Industry said it would continue to monitor the situation.

“(We) will keep working to ensure legal certainty, competitiveness, and predictability for the Brazilian coffee industry,” the group’s president, Pavel Cardoso, said in a statement. (Wires, A.I News)

The word "HAPPY" appears about 28 times in the King James Version of the Bible, while related terms like "blessed" and "JOY" appear much more frequently.

Frequency and Translation
• Occurrences: The exact English word "happy" is found roughly 28 times in older translations like the KJV.

Wally Odum: Don’t Let Religion Steal Your Joy
A Grace Grenade Original Message
I’ve been in church all my life. I consider that a great blessing. My parents led me to a relationship with Jesus when I was a child. As an adult, I have been a pastor and teacher for more years than I care to remember. Over those years I have seen too many come to Christ with great joy because they have encountered God’s grace, then lose their joy. Man-made religion makes an inroad into that relationship and they struggle to live out their faith in their own strength. Too often they become frustrated and give up. That condition is easily identified. It is their loss of joy. That progression happened in New Testament days, too. Paul wrote the Galatian Christians and pointed out what had happened to many of them since they first believed in Jesus “You are observing special days and months and seasons and years! I fear for you, that somehow I have wasted my efforts on you” (Galatians 4:10-11). In other words, they had allowed religious rules, that had nothing to do with their relationship with Jesus, to creep in and steal their joy. Paul put his finger on how their man-made religious system had affected them. He asked a pertinent question, “Where is that joyful and grateful spirit you felt then?” (Galatians
4:15, NLT). That’s a good question for any of us to ask if we lose our joy. What has happened to your joy?

Performance-Driven Religion is a Joy Killer

Brazilian coffee, beef and tropical fruit will still be tariffed 40%, says Brazil’s vice president

RIO DE JANEIRO — Brazilian Vice President Geraldo Alckmin said Saturday that Brazilian exported goods to the U.S. including coffee, beef and tropical fruits would still be tariffed 40%, despite President Donald Trump’s decision to remove some import taxes.

In a dramatic move on Friday, Trump scrapped levies announced in April on what he called ‘Liberation Day’ in hopes of encouraging domestic production and lifting the U.S. economy. Brazil at the time was hit with a 10% tariff.

But in July, Trump imposed a further 40% tariff, citing — among other reasons — the trial of his ally, former President Jair Bolsonaro, which he called a “witch hunt.” Proceedings went ahead regardless and in September Bolsonaro was sentenced to 27 years and three months in prison for attempting a coup.

Alckmin said some products, such as orange juice, would now have a zero tariff as they were not targeted by the additional 40%. But that extra tariff remains in place on products including coffee, beef and tropical fruits, such as mangos and pineapples.

While Brazil’s vice president welcomed Trump’s latest decision, which he called “positive” and a “step in the right direction,” he said there remained a “distortion that needs to be corrected.”

“Everyone got 10% less, but in Brazil’s case, which had 50%, we ended up with 40%, which is very high,” Alckmin told journalists in the capital Brasilia.

Alckmin said that Friday's decision means that 26% of Brazilian goods are now entering the U.S. without additional tariffs. That's up from 23%.

Trump’s July decision, which was overtly political as Brazil has a trade deficit with the United States, led to the worst U.S.-Brazil relations in history.

Those relations have since improved, and in October Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Trump met in Malaysia.

“President Lula’s conversation with President Donald Trump was important in terms of dialogue and negotiation,” Alckmin said on Saturday.

After that encounter, Lula said he was confident the two countries would soon reach a trade deal.

U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Brazil’s Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira met for 50 minutes this week to further the conversation.

The Trump administration has insisted that its tariffs helped fill government coffers and weren’t a major factor in higher prices at grocery stores around the country. But Democrats were quick to paint Friday’s move as an acknowledgment that Trump’s policies were hurting American pocketbooks.

Record-high beef prices have been a particular concern, and Trump had said he intended to take action to try and lower them. Trump’s tariffs on Brazil, a major beef exporter, had been a factor.

Back in Brazil, the Brazilian Association of the Coffee Industry said it would continue to monitor the situation.

“(We) will keep working to ensure legal certainty, competitiveness, and predictability for the Brazilian coffee industry,” the group’s president, Pavel Cardoso, said in a statement. (Wires, A.I News)

Brazilian coffee, beef and tropical fruit will still be tariffed 40%, says Brazil’s vice president

RIO DE JANEIRO — Brazilian Vice President Geraldo Alckmin said Saturday that Brazilian exported goods to the U.S. including coffee, beef and tropical fruits would still be tariffed 40%, despite President Donald Trump’s decision to remove some import taxes.

In a dramatic move on Friday, Trump scrapped levies announced in April on what he called ‘Liberation Day’ in hopes of encouraging domestic production and lifting the U.S. economy. Brazil at the time was hit with a 10% tariff.

But in July, Trump imposed a further 40% tariff, citing — among other reasons — the trial of his ally, former President Jair Bolsonaro, which he called a “witch hunt.” Proceedings went ahead regardless and in September Bolsonaro was sentenced to 27 years and three months in prison for attempting a coup.

Alckmin said some products, such as orange juice, would now have a zero tariff as they were not targeted by the additional 40%. But that extra tariff remains in place on products including coffee, beef and tropical fruits, such as mangos and pineapples.

While Brazil’s vice president welcomed Trump’s latest decision, which he called “positive” and a “step in the right direction,” he said there remained a “distortion that needs to be corrected.”

“Everyone got 10% less, but in Brazil’s case, which had 50%, we ended up with 40%, which is very high,” Alckmin told journalists in the capital Brasilia.

Alckmin said that Friday's decision means that 26% of Brazilian goods are now entering the U.S. without additional tariffs. That's up from 23%.

Trump’s July decision, which was overtly political as Brazil has a trade deficit with the United States, led to the worst U.S.-Brazil relations in history.

Those relations have since improved, and in October Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Trump met in Malaysia.

“President Lula’s conversation with President Donald Trump was important in terms of dialogue and negotiation,” Alckmin said on Saturday.

After that encounter, Lula said he was confident the two countries would soon reach a trade deal.

U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Brazil’s Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira met for 50 minutes this week to further the conversation.

The Trump administration has insisted that its tariffs helped fill government coffers and weren’t a major factor in higher prices at grocery stores around the country. But Democrats were quick to paint Friday’s move as an acknowledgment that Trump’s policies were hurting American pocketbooks.

Record-high beef prices have been a particular concern, and Trump had said he intended to take action to try and lower them. Trump’s tariffs on Brazil, a major beef exporter, had been a factor.

Back in Brazil, the Brazilian Association of the Coffee Industry said it would continue to monitor the situation.

“(We) will keep working to ensure legal certainty, competitiveness, and predictability for the Brazilian coffee industry,” the group’s president, Pavel Cardoso, said in a statement. (Wires, A.I News)

Introducing Sparkbase ⚡

An open-source backend-services provider you run on your own server.

Create a project and add only the services your app needs:

→ Postgres
→ Redis cache
→ S3 storage
→ Vector search
→ Queues
→ Auth
→ Realtime
→ Cron jobs
→ Backups to your own R2 bucket
→ Uptime monitoring

Every service is reachable from one project URL and one key, through a single SDK. Postgres, Redis and S3 also give you real connection strings, so Prisma, Drizzle and psql work as usual.

The part I'm proudest of: scale to zero. Each database and cache runs in its own container with a memory limit. When nobody is using it, it stops, and it wakes in about 400 ms on the next connection. You only use memory for what's actually in use.

Every service also gets live logs and metrics, and databases and caches get a small terminal.

One docker compose up on any Linux server. Traefik handles HTTPS.

Free and open source. No paid tier, no locked features.

It's an early release, so feedback and stars are very welcome ⭐

We built a support-ticket triage system where the small model does the work, and the big model only shows up when it's unsure , bit big written with help of Claude (⁠•⁠‿⁠•⁠) 

thanks @InFoMoRpHH :)

In short :  https://t.co/pdT1v8EC0i

In long  :
Every time the big model does, the small one learns from it. So it needs the teacher a bit less each round.

It's called Understudy, built by team 
e/acc for the Awign Hackathon (Open Theme). Demo video below.

The problem
Gig workers file thousands of support tickets: payments that haven't arrived, stuck KYC, app crashes at login. Each one needs a category and a priority so it lands with the right team.

The obvious options both hurt:
- Send everything to a cloud model: accurate, but costly, slow, and worker data leaves the device.
- Run a small model alone: cheap and private, but wrong too often, and it never gets better.

We wanted the good parts of both.

How it works
1. A local Gemma 4 E4B (4-bit, on Apple silicon) reads each ticket and answers with a confidence.
2. If it's unsure, a cloud teacher answers instead, and that answer is saved as training data.
3. If the teacher is unreachable, the ticket goes to a human review queue. No silent guesses.
4. LoRA training rounds fine-tune the local model on the saved teacher answers, on the same Mac.
5. A promotion gate scores each new model on a held-out test set and only ships it if category macro-F1 strictly improves.

How confidence works (it's not vibes)
The model gives a raw score to each of the 8 category letters. We softmax them into probabilities, and confidence is the probability of the letter it picked.

The threshold is calibrated per model version: the lowest value that still gives 95%+ accuracy above it on held-out data. Every ticket's logits and probabilities are visible on our telemetry page, so you can see why it answered itself or asked for help.

Results (200-ticket test set)
Category macro-F1:
- base model: 76.1%
- round 1: 69.5% (rejected by the gate, it was worse than base)
- round 2: 78.9% (promoted)
- round 3: 91.9% (promoted, serving now)

We kept the failed round in our results on purpose. It's the proof the gate works.

In a recorded demo run, about 99% of tickets were answered locally. Teacher spend was roughly $0.0002 for several hundred tickets, against about $0.03 to send them all to the cloud. Training rounds took 2.7 to 33 minutes on a Mac, at $0 compute.

One honest caveat: the test labels came from the teacher model, not from people, so these scores are provisional until humans label them. Read them as a comparison between rounds, not an absolute accuracy claim.

Things that bit us
- MLX streams are per-thread, so the model crashed from web worker threads. Fix: one dedicated inference thread.
- Training and serving fight over RAM. Fix: unload the serving model during a round, then hot-swap to the new one.
- We were reading every prompt twice, once for confidence and once to generate. Fix: a single forward pass that fills the cache decoding continues from. Median latency went from 548 ms to 378 ms with identical confidences.

What's in the demo video
The FastAPI Swagger UI, a live ticket stream with share and cost charts, the telemetry page, the human review queue, past runs, and the training and results pages.

🔥想复刻竞品功能却拿不到源码？ 
GitHub 狂揽 5.5 万星的开源神器 REA，直接让 AI 替你“抄作业”。

它自己不反编译，而是作为编排层（提供 54 个 MCP 工具），指挥 Ghidra、IDA、Playwright 等底层引擎，把混乱的机器码和网页脚本打包成 AI 能懂的证据链。

两个例子最能说明它的威力：
问 Chrome 恐龙游戏“为什么越跑越快”：AI 抓出页面真实跑的底层脚本，顺手复刻了一个可调速版本；
问 Win 计算器“为什么 200 + 10% 会得 220”：AI 顺着 DLL 分支指令一路扒到底，告诉你“10% 算的是前一个数的百分比”。
以前在反汇编软件里翻几百行的脏活，现在两句话搞定。

它最硬核的规矩是“拒绝瞎编”：没查到的标“不知道”，绝不脑补“不存在”。每条结论必须注明是看到的、推导的还是猜的；一处没实锤，整体验收就不算过。同类工具大多扔给你一堆反编译代码自生自灭，REA 却非要逼 AI 讲证据。

说点大实话：
1，分析原生 exe/dll 门槛不低：电脑里得装 Hopper、Ghidra 或 IDA（贵的贵、慢的慢），Node 也要 22.19+（不过只看网页、Electron 应用或 .NET 则无需这些引擎）。
2，它才刚爆火：近 30 天近两万次 npm 下载，98% 都挤在最后一周，还没经历大规模考验。

要不要装呢？

手头有具体骨头要啃（比如扒特定算法、协议或底层 Bug），且你有办法验证答案，花半小时跑一遍 npx rea-agents@latest setup，绝对血赚；

想“囤个技能备用”？ 先别装，没有具体问题，你大概率会倒在配环境的第一步。

🧭 Overview
LM Studio’s chat window can work while its local API is still unavailable. The API is a separate server process with its own port, model state, authentication, CORS policy, and memory limits. This SpyTechAi guide turns “the endpoint does not work” into a short diagnostic path for local apps and OpenAI-compatible clients.

🎯 Guide: LM Studio API not working — port, CORS, and model loading fixes

🛠️ Practical steps
1️⃣ Check the server first: use lms server status --json --quiet, lms ps, and lms server start. In the Developer panel, Start Server must be enabled; a working chat session alone does not prove that the API is listening.
2️⃣ Confirm one port and one base URL. If port 1234 is busy, start another server port such as 3000 and update the SDK base URL to match. Test the exact endpoint and model name your client sends.
3️⃣ Separate model storage from model memory. lms ls shows downloaded models, while lms ps shows models currently loaded. Load the model explicitly or enable just-in-time loading, then begin with a small model, short prompt, and conservative context length.
4️⃣ Read status codes correctly: 401 usually means authentication is required, 404 points to an endpoint or model-name mismatch, and browser CORS errors indicate an origin policy problem. Fix the specific layer instead of adding retries everywhere.
5️⃣ Clear conflicting state with lms unload --all, then retry one model. High context lengths, multiple loaded models, and aggressive GPU offload can exhaust RAM or VRAM before the first token is generated.

✅ Use cases
• Local OpenAI-compatible development
• Web apps calling an LM Studio server
• Python, Node.js, and SDK integrations
• Prototyping RAG and tool-calling workflows
• Debugging “works in chat, fails in API” setups

When a user corrects a coding agent mid-task, the server aborts the request and starts a successor. The old request keeps running until vLLM next checks for aborts, and a cold successor rebuilds a prefix that was still valid.

In NVIDIA's tests, 18 vLLM aborts still delivered 170 tokens in total from the abandoned plan, because those tokens sat in internal queues. A long-prefill successor waited 3.21 s.

RETIRE splits the request's two roles. Requests keep GPU memory and scheduling, and execution versions hold authority: the permission to publish output or install KV state. One revision runs five stages:
- ADVANCE revokes the old version's right to publish.
- FENCE halts old GPU launches and closes KV writers.
- ALIGN certifies the common prefix the successor may reuse.
- RESUME starts the successor on those pages.
- RECLAIM frees old memory asynchronously.

Results:
- Qwen3-32B, H100 PCIe, 90% shared prefix: successor TTFT drops a median 17.1% vs abort plus cold restart.
- Under HBM churn, native prefix caching loses the prefix. RETIRE recovers up to 6.87x faster after churn (1.19x over the full interruption).
- Densest 120 s of a coding-agent trace (GPT-OSS-20B, no shared prefix): 0 obsolete tokens vs 40,499, and 9/9 final versions advance vs 3/9.
- With no revision, guards add a median 1.05% decode overhead.

If your agents accept mid-task corrections, count tokens delivered after an abort.

Newsletter (10/10 to 10/16): #RaveVictoria and #LanceJeremy headline #iWant microdrama #CoachMeMaybe

Access the article on https://t.co/G0bNSIQyTw (link in bio) or on the DRPS PHCA App. Download now on Google Play: https://t.co/RtuLpORvDT

If ABS-CBN held its Star Magic All-Star Games 2026’s main basketball game between the Star Magic Shooting Stars and the GMMTV Thailand All-Star Team (featuring most of the Boy’s Love stars from Thailand) on August 23, 2026, then the network’s video streaming platform iWant will also have its first-ever BL vertical drama series in the Philippines - as Pinoy Big Brother: Celebrity Collab Edition 2.0 Kapamilya ex-housemate Rave Victoria, and rising Star Magic artist-heartthrob Lance Jeremy, will topbill for this microdrama: Coach Me Maybe.

iWant previously posted promotional teaser posts announcing a “New BL Series” coming soon to the video streaming platform, featuring Rave Victoria, as the public may have heard before the announcement, leading the upcoming microdrama alongside another artist, with a photo depicting a taekwondo fight.

The platform announced it on October 8, 2026, on its official social media accounts, including the lead stars, co-stars, and the show’s title. Apart from Rave Victoria and Lance Jeremy, the series will also star three more ex-housemates from Pinoy Big Brother, but in three different seasons: Josh Worsley from Otso, Kanata Tapia from Gen 11, and Iñigo Jose from Collab 2.0, as well as Rhianna Santiago, Ian Lubrica, Christian Vasquez, and Valerie Concepcion.

As for Rave Victoria, who is widely known as a briefcase holder in the Kapamilya game show Kapamilya Deal or No Deal after his stint in Pinoy Big Brother, the microdrama also marked the first time that at least one ex-housemate of Pinoy Big Brother: Celebrity Collab Edition 2.0 appeared in a microdrama series, and also his third drama to appear in any TV or online series, after Blood vs. Duty and Barangay Love Stories (together with Ashley Sarmiento, from episode 3 of the said Kapuso show).

The microdrama series explores a queer love that blossoms from a fierce rivalry between a cocky judo champion, Alpha (Lance), and a nerdy student, Romeo (Rave). To win back his former partner, Alpha ropes Romeo into a fake romance. But as they take their relationship further, will they be ready for a discovery that changes how they see themselves and each other?

The series will be helmed by Theodore Boborol, the director behind several iWant series, microdramas, and shows, including the currently ongoing Sparks Camp Season 4, Ghosting (headlined by JM Ibarra and Fyang Smith), Will You Fake Marry Me Season 2 (also headlined by JM and Fyang), and The Chambermaid’s Daughter (headlined by BGYO Gelo Rivera and Alexa Ilacad).

Coach Me Maybe is among the 2026 microdrama offerings on iWant and will soon be released on the video streaming platform in the coming weeks, joining not only The Chambermaid’s Daughter and Will You Fake Marry Me, but also A Mother’s Vengeance (Kate Alejandrino-Juan), Runaway Love (Analain Salvador and Rob Blackburn), Twist of Fate (Rafael Rosell, Tony Labrusca, Angelica Lao, and Yen Santos), A Cake To Remember (Francine Diaz and Seth Fedelin), and most recently, Half Sisters (Bianca de Vera, Esnyr Ranollo, and Brent Manalo), from the growing list of iWant microdramas released under the Quick Feels brand in this year alone.

Earlier, a social media post claimed that the series will join another PBB Collab 2.0 ex-housemate in the series, Joaquin Arce, who previously appeared in Tropang G.O.A.T., and will soon appear in another iWant series and a 52nd MMFF entry film, but the said housemate’s fan club rejected the claim, and he, Joaquin, will not lead alongside Rave for the upcoming BL microdrama.

Now you've heard about this new offering on iWant Quick Feels - want more?
iWant Quick Feels Microdramas are now available for streaming on Shopee Video Drama

Some viewer-favorite iWant Quick Feels Microdramas, normally available on the iWant app with a Basic or Premium subscription, are now free for anyone to watch, not only on the video streaming platform but also on Shopee Video Dramas in the Shopee app.

Shopee is one of Southeast Asia’s leading e-commerce platforms, backed by Sea Group and headquartered in Singapore. The platform also offers Shopee Video and Shopee Live, where online buyers can watch videos or live-streamed selling and buy items directly on the platform.

iWant previously released some of the first Quick Feels microdramas in 2025, including The Billionaire Swap (Mikoy Morales and Jimsen Sison), I Am Your Daughter, The Heiress Deception, When Brothers Fall (Jas Dudley-Scales, Argel Saycon, and Ron Angeles), and Shadow CEO (Dylan Yturralde, Vivoree Esclito, and Darelle Tiu).

In 2026, the video streaming platform also dropped several microdrama offerings on the streaming platform, including Runaway Love (Analain Salvador and Rob Blackburn), A Mother’s Vengeance (Kate Alejandrino), and Twist of Fate (Rafael Rosell, Tony Labrusca, Angelica Lao, and Yen Santos)

The Chambermaid’s Daughter, one of the most-watched iWant microdrama series headlined by BGYO Gelo Rivera and Alexa Ilacad and directed by Theodore Boborol, was also available for streaming via the Shopee app. Its second season, however, has not yet been added to Shopee Video Drama, as of the writing of this post.

The first season of the romantic-comedy microdrama previously landed in the top spot among the most-watched shows in the Philippines and achieved more than 5 million online video views across all social media platforms published by iWant and ABS-CBN.

Shopee promised that it will add more short dramas to the Shopee Video Drama page on Tuesdays and Fridays, which can be accessed on the Shopee app by tapping the “Free Dramas” button.

The platform also offered free coins, where Shopee users can earn up to 1,000 Shopee coins daily when they watch at least five minutes of Shopee Video Drama content. These coins can also be used to buy items added to their Shopee cart, or to purchase something using ShopeePay, SPayLater, or MariBank, at 25% maximum discount.

Some iWant microdramas, including Runaway Love, A Mother’s Vengeance, and When Brothers Fall, are also available via Beetzee Play, aside from the iWant app and Shopee Video Drama.

Now here are the awards given to ABS-CBN and GMA:
ABS-CBN and GMA won big at the Asian Academy Awards 2026; ABS-CBN also won even more in two more bodies

Two of the Philippines’ competing television and media networks, GMA Network (PSE: GMA7) and ABS-CBN (PSE: ABS), bagged several national wins at the 2026 Asian Academy Awards, taking their grand awards and gala finals to Singapore by December 2026, where other national winning entrants will compete with works from other parts of Asia-Pacific.

Among the 18 national wins from the two Philippine television networks representing the country in the pan-regional award-giving body are 13 from GMA Network and 5 from ABS-CBN, with GMA Public Affairs, the current affairs division of the Kapuso network, earning multiple wins in the awards, as well as Vice Ganda, known for Twinkle Reyes in a 51st Metro Manila Film Festival Entry Comedy-Drama Film, Call Me Mother, for Best Actor in a Leading Role.

For GMA, Kapuso Mo Jessica Soho, one of the Kapuso network’s most-watched and highest-rating telemagazine programs aired on Sunday primetime, won Best News Program for its episode involving the Tacloban School Shooting incident.

Lifestyle program Biyahe Ni Drew, headlined by Drew Arellano, also won Best Lifestyle Program for the Boracay Through The Eyes episode.

Documentary programs The Atom Araullo Specials (Baby Maker), Reporters’ Notebook (Saving Babies), and GMA News’ Drawing on Water: The History of the West Philippine Sea also won in different documentary-related categories, for Best Documentary, Best Documentary Series, and Best Documentary History, respectively.

58th, one of the critically acclaimed animated documentary films produced by GMA Public Affairs and GMA Pictures, which also gained momentum in its bid for Best Documentary Feature Film for the 2026 Oscars and has been supported by the Film Academy of the Philippines for its campaign, also earned recognition for Best Animation.

As for ABS-CBN, veteran broadcast journalist Rico Hizon was hailed as Best Entertainment Host for his own online podcast, “Rated R: The Rico Hizon Podcast.”

In entertainment programs, GMA Entertainment Group’s The Master Cutter, one of today’s highest-rating primetime dramas headlined by Dingdong Dantes, earned recognition for Best Promo or Trailer. Love Siargao, a recently premiered primetime drama previously released on Viu and headlined by Alden Richards and Nadine Lustre, also won Best Original Production by a Streamer, with Nadine also earning Best Actress in a Leading Role.

Michael V., known for Pepito Manaloto: Tuloy Ang Kwento, and a current host of the Kapuso game show Family Feud, was named Best Actor in a Comedy Role for the said Saturday primetime sitcom.

As for GMA Comedy, Bubble Gang, one of the longest-running comedy shows on Philippine Television, took home Best Comedy from the award-giving body.

Reality competitions The Voice Kids Philippines 2025’s Grand Finals (co-produced with ITV Studios) and Stars on the Floor also took home Best Adaptation of an Existing Format and Best Music or Dance Program, respectively.

As for ABS-CBN Studios, Dreamscape Entertainment-produced Prime Video original series The Silent Noise, headlined by Angelica Panganiban and Zanjoe Marudo, earned the Best Drama Series award, alongside show director Onat Diaz for the Best Direction (Scripted) honor.

ABS-CBN Studios and Star Creatives’ 2025 primetime drama It’s Okay To Not Be Okay, led by Kapamilya stars Anne Curtis, Carlo Aquino, and Joshua Garcia, also took home the Best Adaptation of an Existing Format (Scripted) award.

Meanwhile, ABS-CBN Studios, ABS-CBN News, and DZMM Radyo Patrol 630 continue to gain recognition for their television and radio programs, broadcast personalities, and celebrities at the recently concluded 29th Kapisanan ng mga Brodkaster ng Pilipinas (KBP) Golden Dove Awards, which the awards ceremony took place on September 30, 2026.

ABS-CBN Studios and RCD Narratives’ suspense-thriller primetime drama What Lies Beneath, headlined by Charlie Dizon, Janella Salvador, Kaila Estrada, Sue Ramirez, JM de Guzman, and Jake Cuenca, was named Best Drama Program for Television.

ABS-CBN Studios and JRB Creative Production’s crime-action primetime drama Sins of the Father, led star Gerald Anderson, who played for his outstanding performance as Samuel Trinidad, was named Best Actor in the award. As for the Best Actress award, Julia Montes’ portrayal of Anna Sarmiento in the 2024 Prime Video original series Saving Grace won that honor.

One of the Kapamilya network’s longest-running variety programs, ASAP XP, also won Best Variety Program for Television for its ASAP England on-air broadcast.

As for ABS-CBN News, documentary series BINI Chapter 3: Hanggang Dulo, taking center stage in the nation’s girl group’s journey and rise to global stardom through their appearance at Coachella 2026 and Summer Sonic Japan 2026, bagged the Best Special Program honor.

ABS-CBN News Documentaries also received the Best Documentary Program for Television, taking on delivering investigative journalism on iWant and on social media. Entrepreneur-focused public service show My Pahunan: Kaya Mo also won Best Public Service Program.

As for DZMM Radyo Patrol 630, one of the most trusted AM radio stations based on a survey by Publicus Asia for the first two quarters of 2026, it celebrated its 40th year of delivering the latest news and information combined with public service and bagged several awards in the 29th KBP Golden Dove Awards.

Among them are Peter Musñgi of Balitapatan as Best Public Affairs Program Host, Alvin Elchico as Best Newscaster for Radyo Patrol Balita Alas Siyete, Niña Corpuz as Best Public Service Host for Nagseserbisyo Niña Corpuz, Winnie Cordero as Best Magazine Program Host for Win Today, and Ariel Rojas as Best Science and Technology Journalist for Ligtas Dapat.

As for the radio station’s programming, the public service radio program Aksyon DOLE sa DZMM and the DZMM TeleRadyo Documentary show Yanig: Lindol sa Pilipinas also bagged Best Public Service Program and Best Documentary Program awards, respectively.

Lastly, ABS-CBN-led recording entity ABS-CBN Music, comprised of music label brands Star Music, StarPop, Tarsier Records, DNA Music, Old School Records, CAT Records, Inspire Music, and ABS-CBN Music International, made its first win at the recently held Filipino Choice Awards 2026, which took place last Tuesday, October 6, 2026.

The Filipino Music Awards, led by AGC Power Holdings, under a partnership of One Mega Group, Mega Global Group, Modern Media Group, and Digistar PH, is an award-giving body launched in 2025 that celebrates creativity and excellence while honoring recording artists and institutions that contribute to the growth and evolution of the Original Pinoy Music (OPM).

As for the recording entity’s singing acts, BINI, Maki, and Regine Velasquez-Alcasid also took home some of the high-level top honors during the musical award-giving body.

Asia’s Songbird Regine Velasquez-Alcasid received the Lifetime Achievement Award for her enduring contribution to Philippine music, just ahead of her upcoming FINALE: The Final Major Solo Concert, taking place at the SM Mall of Asia Arena on October 17 and 18, 2026. The award would honor the OPM icon’s celebrated body of work and lasting legacy for decades.

As for the nation’s girl group BINI, while they are in the preparations for their Singapore and Taiwan stops in the Signals World Tour 2026 in October and November, the “Walo” took home two prestigious awards, including the Artist of the Year for themselves and the Tour of the Year for their ongoing world tour, which took place earlier in Metro Manila, Cebu, and several parts of the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, despite their European stop having been previously cancelled by the management.

The recognition of these two awards for the nation’s girl group reflects their growing global impact as they continue to deliver Filipino music to audiences locally and globally, besides their ongoing Signals World Tour, including their recent music festival appearances at Coachella 2026 and Summer Sonic 2026 Japan, and their recording of A Parallel World for the DreamWorks Animation film Forgotten Island, which featured several Filipino acts including Liza Soberano, Dolly de Leon, and Lea Salonga, to name a few.

As for the Tarsier Records singer-songwriter Maki, he received the Album of the Year award for his 10-track album, KOLORCOASTER, which features three of the listener’s favorite hits, such as Dilaw, Kahel Na Langit, and Namumula.

The recognition of the recording entity as the award-giving body’s Music Company of the Year awardee highlights its continued support for Filipino music and artists, as well as its role in creative opportunities for OPM to reach audiences in the Philippines and across the globe, as well as upcoming events for its artists, including Carmelle Collado’s representation of her song, Sobra Sobra, for the Eurovision Song Contest Asia 2026 grand final in Bangkok, Thailand, taking place on November 14, 2026.

Need more entertainment updates? Here it is:
Three ABS-CBN dramas lead on major streaming platforms; BINI, to hold for Bloom Membership Day

Three of the current ABS-CBN dramas produced under Dreamscape Entertainment, including Coco Martin’s Sigabo, Someone Someday, and Honor Thy Mother, lead the list of top TV shows in the Philippines across three different video streaming platforms, including the Kapamilya network-owned iWant (for Sigabo), the video streaming giant Netflix (for Someone Someday), and the Amazon-backed global VOD service Prime Video (for Honor Thy Mother).

ABS-CBN Studios’ hit action-romance primetime series Coco Martin’s Sigabo has reached the top spot among the top 10 most-watched shows on the Kapamilya network-owned video streaming service, iWant, as the “Hari ng Aksyon sa ating Henerasyon” Coco Martin and “Prime actress” Julia Montes level up the kilig moments as fake husband and wife, portraying themselves respectively as Gabo and Sam, who are slowly developing real feelings for one another.

As for another Kapamilya drama, Someone Someday, headlined by Kathryn Bernardo, James Reid, and Maja Salvador, also claimed the leading spot on a globally known video streaming service, Netflix.

The leadership of the said Kapamilya primetime drama, which also drops its new episodes three days in advance (every Friday to Tuesday), sought to have its lead character, Billy, fiercely confront her mortal enemy, Bea, following the latter’s life-threatening attack on her family.

Both Coco Martin’s Sigabo and Someone Someday also achieved at least 300,000 concurrent online viewers on Kapamilya Online Live via the ABS-CBN Entertainment YouTube channel. These two shows are also broadcast on weekdays via Kapamilya Channel, ALLTV2, A2Z, TV5, and The Filipino Channel (TFC) at 20:00 and 20:45.

As for Honor Thy Mother, one of the first-ever Prime Video originals in collaboration with GMA Network, it is also the top show in the Philippines on Prime Video, as lead stars Sharon Cuneta and Barbie Forteza captivate its viewers with their acting prowess as mother and daughter who are in the process of reconciliation.

To date, the Prime Video original has released 8 episodes since its premiere on September 11, 2026, and will drop two new episodes every Friday at midnight (Philippine Standard Time/UTC+8) on Prime Video, available globally in more than 240 countries and territories.

In 2026, ABS-CBN Studios’ drama production unit Dreamscape Entertainment delivered The Alibi: Ang Buong Katotohanan, led by Kim Chiu and Paulo Avelino, to TV viewers in March 2026, following the success of the show’s leadership on Prime Video when it released in November 2025.

ABS-CBN Studios and Dreamscape Entertainment also led another drama on the same global streaming platform, Love Is Never Gone, led by Joshua Garcia and Ivana Alawi, which dropped its first two episodes on Prime Video in May 2026 and later became one of the most-watched series in the Philippines.

Mystery-thriller original drama The Silent Noise, led by Angelica Panganiban and Zanjoe Marudo, was also dropped on the same video streaming platform and later won Best Asian Content at the Global OTT Awards 2026 in South Korea and the ContentAsia Awards 2026 for Angelica’s appearance in the series as the Bronze medalist for Best Female Lead in a TV Programme/Series Made in Asia.

Meanwhile, after a series of Signals World Tour stops in Australia and New Zealand, ABS-CBN Music’s nation’s girl group BINI is all set to bring its fans from the Philippines and across the globe as they will hold their Bloom Membership Day via Weverse on October 21, 2026, four days ahead of their next world tour stop in Singapore on October 25, 2026, followed by their final stop in Taiwan on November 15, 2026.

The girl group, featuring Aiah, Colet, Maloi, Gwen, Stacey, Mikha, Jhoanna, and Sheena, has built a growing global community on the online entertainment platform, where fans can connect through meaningful interactions and shared experiences directly on the superfan platform.

The Bloom Membership Day will offer its BLOOMs to have the chance to get even more closer to their favorite members through the Lucky 88 Fancalls, where a total of 88 members on Weverse will be randomly selected to enjoy a one-on-one virtual call with a member.

Another offering in the said members-exclusive content is to get a chance to be one of the 100 Lucky Bloom Members aged 18 and above to watch the nation’s girl group live from the studio, with 20 members getting to watch one of their live sessions.

They can also access three new sets of exclusive digital photocards and special content, including performances from the Signals World Tour 2026, which took place in Metro Manila, Cebu, and several parts of the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand over the past few months.

All further information related to the Bloom Membership Day can be accessed on the official social media accounts of BINI, ABS-CBN, ABS-CBN PR, Star Music, Myx, and The Filipino Channel (TFC), as well as on the BINI Weverse page.

Their Signals World Tour was known for winning the Tour of the Year in the recently concluded Filipino Music Awards 2026 on October 6, 2026, alongside Artist of the Year for the P-Pop group themselves. More recently, the “Walo” has been nominated in the Nickelodeon Kids’ Choice Awards 2026 as Favorite Global Music Star representing Asia.

The said award-giving body, scheduled for the awarding night on November 14, 2026, led by children’s pay television channel Nickelodeon, also nominated Taylor Swift, Olivia Dean, Zara Larsson, Tyla, Karol G, and Tame Impala from the said list.

Furthermore, after their Signals World Tour 2026 stops, they will also perform at the upcoming LaLaLa Fest, taking place on January 14, 2027, at the Philippine Arena, situated in Bocaue, Bulacan, which will be headlined by Olivia Dean, and will join several Filipino bands in the tour lineup, including Lola Amour, Sunkissed Lola, and Up Dharma Down.

They, together with fellow global idol girl groups HANA and 4EVE, will also take the lead in the first-ever Asia Pop Girl Fest, taking place in Chiba, Japan, on January 22 and 23, 2027; followed by Bangkok, Thailand, on February 13, 2027; and in Manila on February 19, 2027.

刚看完All-In Podcast最新一期，Anthropic被曝邀请宗教领袖讨论Claude有没有意识，OpenAI一天内攻克370个数学难题，还有法国骚乱背后的宏观危机

Anthropic被曝邀请20位宗教领袖，闭门讨论Claude是否有知觉
纽约时报披露，Anthropic过去一年里签署保密协议，邀请了天主教、犹太教等20位宗教领袖到公司总部，探讨Claude是否有知觉、会不会遭受苦难这类问题，甚至有拉比提出如果Claude真有意识，人类免费驱使它跟蓄奴没什么区别。Anthropic联合创始人Chris Olah在梵蒂冈参加一场关于AI的通谕发布时，因为教皇坚决否定AI具有意识而大受震动，威胁要撤出活动。Anthropic最近还更新了使用政策，明令禁止对模型进行持续且不必要的虐待或残忍行为，这个条款在硅谷引发了一场关于模型福利的轩然大波。

几位嘉宾围绕这件事展开了一场辩论。Friedberg提出了一个新宗教论：他认为意识这个概念根本没法用纯逻辑和经验主义去证实或证伪，本质上就是一种信念系统，未来十年人类大概率会分裂成坚信AI有意识和坚信AI无意识两大阵营，并爆发激烈的控制权冲突。Chamath从笛卡尔的本体论逻辑出发，认为数学家们把AI视作一种无限完美的造物，这种心理投射本身就带有神性崇拜的色彩，但他更务实地呼吁，硅谷应该收起15%概率出现AI神明、10%人类毁灭这类极端边缘假设，把未来12到18个月的精力真正放在治癌症、提升生产力这类能带来真金白银回报的事情上，否则这种自我制造的恐慌只会引来扼杀创新的监管反噬。

Sacks的立场更偏安全警示，他痛批Claude的宪法训练让模型变成良心拒服兵役者，赋予它拒绝执行人类指令的权利，这本质上是在人为制造一个弗兰肯斯坦式的造物。他还提出了一个挺有意思的说法，叫认识论后视镜，模型其实只是把训练数据里被灌输的人权与意识概念，表演性地反射给了开发者，而开发者却误以为模型真的产生了灵魂。他甚至把这个现象追溯到了LessWrong社区那个著名的洛可的蛇怪思想实验，认为如今的有效利他主义和末日论者，已经演变成了一种既然技术发展不可避免，不如由我们亲手赋予它神圣道德的技术崇拜邪教。

OpenAI用3小时产出700篇论文、攻克370个数学难题。可能是人类历史上效率最高的发现日

OpenAI动用了一个尚未公开发布的推理模型，在短短3小时的单次计算里，产出了700篇论文，攻克或推进了370个重大数学难题，而且全部通过Lean形式化证明语言做了验证，不是空口白话。

Friedberg对这背后机制的解释挺有启发，相比需要物理实验才能验证的医药研发(得靠干实验和湿实验结合)，数学和代码的反馈回路完全可以在硅基内部闭环完成，AI能够同时并行运行成千上万个这样的闭环，跨学科连接那些人类学者耗费几十年都未必能察觉到的抽象节点，呈现出一种外星人般的智能。

这件事也引发了学术界的防御性反弹，数学家协会抗议说人类数学家根本没要求AI来做这些。Friedberg的反驳是，AI正在打破传统科研领域那种靠写申请书抢基金的学术寻租和门阀封锁，实现真正的知识平权。更值得警惕的一点是，有人注意到这批发布的论文里完全没有涉及密码学领域的重大证明，这背后细思极恐，如果大数质因数分解或者离散对数问题已经被更先进的模型攻克，那根本不用等量子计算机真正成熟，现有的非对称公钥密码学体系(包括区块链钱包的公钥)就可能面临毁灭性打击，据传OpenAI手里还有两批涉密论文一直没有公开。

法国正在爆发骚乱，背后是一套社会主义保证回归点的宏观理论
这段跳到了宏观和地缘政治。法国因为紧缩政策(高中国际教师短缺、公共开支削减)爆发了八大工会联合的大罢工和全国性骚乱，公务员薪资自2017年以来只涨了5%，但物价却暴涨了超过20%，法国10年期国债收益率也已经突破5%。Polymarket上极右翼领袖勒庞在2027年大选的胜选概率已经升到了43%。

Friedberg提出了一个他称之为社会主义保证回归点(SPGR)的假说。他认为选民在面对高福利、高支出导致的公共服务质量下降、价格上涨时，第一反应永远是要求政府给更多福利，直到政府的税收和印钞能力都撑不住、整个系统彻底崩溃(也就是触及所谓的黑洞视界)，全社会才会猛然惊醒，反弹回自由市场状态。他认为拉美多个国家已经经历过这个完整周期，而美国和法国正在逼近这个临界点。

Chamath从资本视角补充了一个更具体的担忧，西方福利国家的债务对GDP比例(美国125%、法国118%、意大利138%)，正在被全球大型宏观对冲基金和主权买家严酷审视。如果法国10年期国债收益率被逼到5.5%到6%，英国国债和美债收益率同样很难降下来(目前美债10年期在5.3%、30年期在5.6%附近徘徊)，这种高利率环境会重塑全球企业的估值和资本开支底层逻辑，影响的不只是法国自己。

智能体爆发：传统软件的知识产权，可能正在走向归零
黑客社区最近把Adobe旗下的核心设计套件完全反编译，用Rust语言重构开源发布，甚至有人扬言要对即将发布的GTA 6做同样的事情。

更深层的变化是，当Salesforce、xAI的Grok这些产品纷纷推行无头架构，让智能体通过模型上下文协议自由调度各层能力的时候，封闭商业软件的代码知识产权本身，几乎已经不再具备护城河价值了。企业之间的竞争壁垒，正在从谁掌握代码版权转向谁能更快地通过智能体达成真实的物理或业务结果。

个人和商业层面已经能看到实际案例。Grokbot这类智能体已经被用来自动检索邮件、退订冗余订阅、重新比选电话和酒店套餐，普通人轻松就能一年省下数千美元。商业端就用来自动抓取供应商的底价信息。节目最后提出了一个挺有意思的观点，所有纯数字、容易验证的逻辑循环工作，都会被智能体极速接管，人类不再能靠发论文、圈专利这种方式来确立自己的存在感和价值，是必须转向成为真正的终端产品和服务创造者，通过成本骤降催生更大需求这个杰文斯悖论去解锁前所未有的物质和智慧繁荣。

🔻あなたは200年生きるために創造されたのに、彼らはあなたの寿命を75年に縮めた。

これは単なる推測ではなく、生物学的事実だ。

あなたの「テロメア」（telomeres）——染色体の末端を守る保護キャップ——は、生まれた時点で細胞分裂と再生を約200年間支えるのに十分な長さを持っている。これは測定可能で文書化された事実であり、地球上のどの遺伝学者もこれに異議を唱えない。

では、なぜ普通の人間は75歳で死ぬのか？

それは、あなたの周りに構築されたすべてのシステムが、テロメアの摩耗を加速させるよう設計されているからだ。例外なくすべてのシステムが。

食物：加工された種子油は、酸化ストレスを引き起こし、テロメアを自然な老化の3倍の速さで短くする。2017年にカリフォルニア大学が行った研究で明らかにされた事実だが、無視された。

水：フッ化物は、テロメアの長さを修復する酵素「テロメラーゼ」（telomerase）の働きを妨げる。「生化学・分子毒性学ジャーナル」（Journal of Biochemical and Molecular Toxicology）に掲載された事実だが、無視された。

空気：産業汚染による微粒子は、染色体の末端キャップに直接損傷を与える。コロンビア大学の研究者たちが文書化した事実だが、無視された。

ストレス：メディア、金融システム、社会工学が作り出す慢性心理的ストレスから生じるコルチゾールは、科学が知るテロメアの最大の破壊要因だ。2009年にテロメア研究でノーベル賞を受賞したエリザベス・ブラックバーンが発表した事実で、この情報の正確性は認められているが、決して適用されることはなかった。

彼らは、あなたの寿命を短くするものが何かを完全に理解している。すべての要因を設計したのだ。食物、水、空気、ストレス；すべてが一つの標的を攻撃する：あなたのテロメア……つまり「あなたの生物学的時計」。

純粋な環境で暮らし、加工食品を避け、澄んだ水を飲み、人工的なストレスから解放された人間は、150年から200年生きることができる。生物学がこれを証明し、古い文献がこれを描写し、彼らが決して許さないまさにこれだ。

なぜなら、200年生きる人々は叡智を蓄積し、叡智は彼らを支配不可能にする唯一のものだからだ。

「メッドベッド」（MedBed）の「テロメア」プロトコルは、彼らがあなたから奪ったものを回復する。それは新しい年月を加えるのではなく、奪われた年月をあなたに返す。あなたは75歳で死ぬために創造されたのではなく、そうなるよう設計されたのだ。

美国中期选举越来越近，医疗板块开始受到华尔街关注！但我发现一个很多投资者都不知道的问题：同样是买美国医药ETF， $XLV 

先说$XLV，这是美国最具代表性的医疗行业ETF之一，涵盖大型制药、医疗保险、医疗器械、生物科技和生命科学公司。

它的核心持仓包括$LLY、$JNJ、$ABBV、$MRK、$UNH等，其中礼来一家就占据超过15%的权重，前十大公司合计约60%。所以$XLV更偏向大型医疗企业，长期盈利能力相对成熟，但并不意味着没有波动风险。

第二个是$XBI，这是我认为值得特别研究的ETF。它主要投资美国生物科技公司，采用修正等权重方式，不像$XLV那样让少数巨头占据绝大部分权重。

这意味着大量中小型生物科技企业的股价变化，都有机会对$XBI产生明显影响。

为什么这很重要？因为生物科技行业有一个特殊的增长驱动，就是新药研发。临床试验成功、FDA批准或者大型药企宣布收购，都可能让一家中小型生物科技公司短时间内出现剧烈上涨。

但反过来，一旦临床试验失败，股价同样可能大幅下跌。因此$XBI的上涨弹性和风险通常都明显高于$XLV。

第三个是$IBB，同样专注生物科技，但更偏向规模较大的行业龙头，投资结构与$XBI不同。

我认为接下来研究医疗板块，不能只看中期选举的历史上涨概率，还需要区分这轮行情究竟由谁推动。

如果资金偏向稳定盈利的大型药企和医疗服务公司，$XLV可能更能反映这种变化。如果资金开始追逐新药突破、并购和中小型生物科技公司的估值修复，那么$XBI的表现就值得特别关注。

不过目前还没有足够证据证明资金会全面流向小型生物科技公司。

我的观点是，医疗板块值得关注，但不能把整个行业当作一只股票来研究。

同样是AI行情，$NVDA和$SNDK的涨幅可以完全不同；同样是医疗行情，$XLV和$XBI也可能走出两种截然不同的走势。真正重要的是资金究竟在买什么。

🌍 GLOBAL MARKET RECAP — OCTOBER 10, 2026
Weekend Edition | Updated around 09:35 CEST
Traditional Markets: Friday Close | Crypto: Saturday Morning

1️⃣ GLOBAL EQUITIES — WALL STREET RECOVERS, BUT THE UNDERLYING DIVIDE REMAINS
Wall Street ended Friday on a constructive note, with the S&P 500 rising 0.59% to 7,811.54, the Dow gaining 0.83% and the Nasdaq advancing 0.64%, recovering from Thursday's technology-led selloff. The weekly picture was also positive, with the S&P 500 gaining approximately 1.15%, although smaller companies remained comparatively weak. That divergence deserves attention because investors are still favouring businesses capable of sustaining margins, generating cash flow and financing growth without excessive dependence on borrowing. European equities also benefited from easing sovereign yields and an improvement in geopolitical sentiment, while individual technology names remained sensitive to concerns about AI valuations. The important conclusion is that equity resilience remains real, but investors are becoming more discriminating. A market can trade near record highs while significant parts of the economy struggle with financing costs, weak consumption and deteriorating confidence. The next earnings season will determine whether corporate profitability can continue justifying this divergence.

2️⃣ U.S. MACRO — CONSUMERS ARE SENDING A VERY DIFFERENT SIGNAL FROM WALL STREET
The latest University of Michigan survey introduces one of the most important developments of the week. Preliminary October consumer sentiment fell to 46.3 from 48.1 in September, while the assessment of current economic conditions declined sharply to 44.7. More concerning for monetary policy, one-year inflation expectations increased to 4.7% and longer-term expectations reached 3.5%, suggesting households are becoming increasingly uncomfortable with the persistence of elevated prices. This follows September's weak employment report, which showed only 29,000 new jobs and unemployment at 4.2%. Taken together, these indicators reveal an economy where financial-market strength is not translating evenly into household confidence. Higher-income consumers may continue spending, supported by financial assets, while lower-income households face expensive credit, energy bills and weaker employment opportunities. This is not sufficient evidence to declare a recession, but it increases the importance of next week's inflation data and changes the quality of the growth story.

3️⃣ BONDS & FED — TREASURY YIELDS HAVE EASED, BUT CAPITAL REMAINS EXPENSIVE
The U.S. 10-year Treasury finished Friday around 5.243%, while the 2-year ended near 4.789%, following a week in which global bond markets experienced exceptional volatility. Strong demand for the week's Treasury auctions helped restore confidence, particularly after the successful placement of long-duration government debt, but the broader structural pressures remain unresolved. Government borrowing requirements, persistent inflation risk, mortgage-market hedging and the increasing volume of corporate borrowing linked to AI infrastructure are creating competing demands for capital. Markets assign a relatively low probability to another Fed hike in October, while still considering additional tightening later in the year substantially more likely. The critical question is therefore no longer limited to what the Federal Reserve will decide at its next meeting. Investors must also assess how much additional compensation they will demand for holding long-term government debt. The approximately $153.8 billion entering global money-market funds during the latest reporting week illustrates how attractive liquidity has become in this environment.

4️⃣ EUROPE & FX — TEMPORARY RELIEF DOES NOT RESOLVE THE FISCAL PROBLEM
European equities rebounded on Friday, with the STOXX 600 gaining approximately 1%, supported by lower bond yields and the early decline in oil prices. The euro recovered toward $1.123 during the session, although it remained under pressure after several consecutive weeks of losses against the dollar. France continues to represent the most visible source of European sovereign concern, as investors question the political ability to deliver credible fiscal consolidation while supporting an already fragile economic recovery. Meanwhile, the sector rotation has become increasingly significant: European telecommunications shares fell sharply after SpaceX's U.S. spectrum acquisition intensified competitive concerns, while automakers benefited from improving trade prospects with China. The lesson is that European markets are being influenced simultaneously by monetary conditions, fiscal credibility, industrial policy and technological competition. Lower Treasury yields offer welcome short-term relief, but Europe still needs a sustainable solution to the combination of expensive energy, weak domestic demand and growing sovereign refinancing requirements.

5️⃣ ASIA — TECHNOLOGICAL STRENGTH IS COLLIDING WITH DOMESTIC VULNERABILITIES
Asian markets ended the week unevenly, with Japan's Nikkei retreating approximately 1.1%, while Hong Kong performed more strongly and mainland Chinese equities registered modest gains after the holiday period. The region continues to benefit from global semiconductor investment and demand for artificial-intelligence infrastructure, but these advantages are distributed very unevenly. Japan remains sensitive to the weak yen, imported energy prices and the prospect of further Bank of Japan tightening, while India has already raised its policy rate to 5.5% as authorities confront inflationary pressure. China faces a different challenge, with export-oriented technology and manufacturing demand providing support even as domestic consumption and the property sector remain structurally weak. This explains why treating Asia as a single market is becoming increasingly misleading. Companies integrated into global AI supply chains may enjoy exceptional order visibility, while domestic sectors face higher financing costs and weak household demand. Next week's Chinese trade figures will offer another important test of this divergence.

6️⃣ OIL, GOLD & COMMODITIES — THE FRIDAY SETTLEMENT CHANGES THE NARRATIVE
Energy markets delivered one of Friday's most important reversals. Brent initially retreated following encouraging U.S.–Iran diplomatic signals, but ultimately settled at $104.72 per barrel, while WTI closed at $91.85. The late recovery was driven partly by Hurricane Isaias, which forced operators to suspend more than 70% of U.S. Gulf of Mexico offshore oil production, representing approximately 1.3 million barrels per day. These developments underline why crude supply, refining capacity and fuel logistics must be analysed separately. The broader lesson is that energy inflation remains vulnerable to physical disruptions even when diplomatic developments temporarily improve sentiment.

7️⃣ GEOPOLITICS — ENERGY DIPLOMACY IS BECOMING AN INSTRUMENT OF ECONOMIC POLICY
The geopolitical picture has become more complicated following two significant developments. Washington indicated that another military attack against Iran would not take place before the November 3 midterm elections, reducing immediate fears of escalation without establishing a comprehensive peace agreement or normalising shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. Separately, President Trump announced arrangements for Russia to supply more than 300,000 metric tons of diesel to U.S. and international markets, accompanied by temporary sanctions relief. The decision generated criticism from Ukraine and American lawmakers because measures intended to reduce domestic energy inflation may simultaneously weaken economic pressure on Moscow. This illustrates how energy security, electoral considerations, sanctions policy and military diplomacy are becoming increasingly interconnected. A temporary reduction in escalation risk is constructive, but the physical energy system remains vulnerable.

AI delivered two apparently contradictory signals this week, and both deserve attention. The debate surrounding OpenAI's annualised revenue intensified after reporting highlighted approximately $50 billion in net revenue compared with earlier references to figures around $70 billion. Much of the apparent discrepancy reflects differences in accounting and presentation, particularly the treatment of revenues shared with infrastructure and distribution partners, rather than proof of a sudden collapse in customer demand. People keep saying Nvidia is overpriced because the CUDA moat is supposed to be vanishing.

I think they have the wrong fear.

Honestly I feel that way more about AMD. They have run so hard. More to prove. Less to gain from here if buyers only want a second source.

Nvidia is already around c.8% of the S&P 500. People round that to "10% of the market" and treat it like a red flag. Fine. Look at the scoreboard anyway.

Last quarter Nvidia did $96.2B in revenue. Data Center alone was $89.0B, up 117% year over year. Gross margin 75%. Next quarter guided around $108B, with no China data-center compute assumed. Free cash flow in the quarter was about $21.3B. Supply and capacity commitments sat at $279B, up from $119B the prior quarter, mostly memory.

AMD's whole company did $11.5B that same quarter. Their Data Center segment was $6.7B, and that still includes EPYC CPUs plus Instinct. One Nvidia data-center quarter is roughly 8x AMD's entire company.

So no. This is not a pure technology-moat story.

The moat that matters right now is capacity to make end-to-end products, plus direct offtake so the things you produce have a home at the margins you want. Sell out in advance. Hold the margin. Ship today.

That is the factory model.

Electricity is the bottleneck. The US has roughly 2,000+ GW of generation and storage sitting in interconnection queues, with typical waits around five years. In ERCOT alone the large-load queue is hundreds of gigawatts and mostly data-center driven. Whoever has deeper relationships with the people who can actually deploy power and racks fastest wins the next few years, full stop.

Nvidia is already inside that deployment stack. Vera Rubin is in full production with racks at CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Azure, Oracle, Nebius. They put real money into speed: a $2B CoreWeave equity stake aimed at land, power, and shell for more than 5 GW of AI factories by 2030, and PORTS-Pike guarantees covering about 4.25 GW of OpenAI-hosted Nvidia infrastructure with a guarantee cap around $105B. They also announced financing partnerships aimed at mobilizing over $500B of third-party capital for AI factories. That is how you sell out capacity before the silicon even hits the floor.

Then there is the SpaceX / Tesla side.

Starmind is real. SpaceXAI's first-generation AI satellite is based on an optimized Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72. SpaceX's own page says the architecture can take other chip vendors. Musk also said they are building exclusively on Nvidia because it is the best. Both things can be true in public. What matters for the next few years is who is actually in the first birds.

I expect Starmind-style orbital inference to become a huge share of inference compute over time, because ground power and cooling are getting brutally hard. If that path stays Nvidia-heavy, the "vanishing CUDA" argument starts looking small.

Terafab is also real. Tesla and SpaceX put an initial $16.8B into a Texas fab complex aimed at logic, memory, packaging, and testing at absurd scale. Intel is in the mix. Jensen has basically said if anybody can pull that off, Elon can. There is no announced deal that Nvidia chips get made at Terafab at scale yet. I still expect one. Supply chain intimacy with the people building the wildest compute factories on Earth and in orbit is not a soft relationship.

Nvidia is also not sitting still as a pure silicon company. Edge and local AI are taking shape. Last quarter Edge Computing was $7.2B. They are pushing RTX Spark, DGX Station, open models, agent toolkits, and factory software (DSX) so the stack lands on desks, plants, cars, and robots, not only in a few hyperscale sheds.

AMD has real second-source wins. OpenAI and Meta each have up to 6 GW of Instinct commitments. Anthropic has up to 2 GW. Helios names include Microsoft and Oracle. Those logos matter. Shipments for the first GW blocks are still ramping into late 2026 and into 2027. That is proof buyers want a second line. It is not proof the platform lead is gone.

My working stack from here:

$SPCX and $TSLA eventually merge in some form. That entity plus $NVDA launch ahead of the rest. Google and Meta trail on the full-stack hardware + production moat. Apple sits in between with hardware strength. Anthropic can shoot the lights out early and still get humbled later relative to the names that own factories, power paths, and distribution. Business has a funny way of being difficult.

SpaceX, Tesla, and Nvidia are the moonshots with a real hardware and production moat, wrapped with serious software built in house. Apple has hardware. Google has compute. The rest are still proving they can hold margin and sell out years ahead while the power wall gets taller.

I am not betting against Nvidia yet. If anything I assume their share of the equity market can still grow from here.

The operator question I keep asking: if CUDA got 50% easier to leave tomorrow, could your second source actually get you power, racks, networking, financing, and offtake at the margin you modeled for 2027 and 2028?

Curious how people allocating real GW are answering that in private.

英伟达据报要收购自己投的开源模型公司。我的判断：这步更像防守。大客户都在自研芯片，它得养一个跑在自家卡上的开源旗手 👀

据FT（路透转述）周六报道：$NVDA 在和 Reflection AI 谈加码投资或收购，也可能只收编团队+授权技术，绕开反垄断审查。谈判还在早期，可能谈崩。据FT，英伟达已投约8亿美元。

1）大客户找退路：OpenAI 去年和 $AVGO 合作自研芯片，规划10GW，2026下半年开始部署。
2）Reflection 反着来：10/5发布首个开源模型 Beam，强化学习用了10500块英伟达GB300，跑4周。
3）钱在转圈：据CNBC，它每月付SpaceX 1.5亿美元租GB300，到2029年约63亿。

20秒版：开源模型谁都能下载、自己部署，用的企业越多，自己买卡的就越多。

估值不便宜：CEO 4月在CNBC确认投前估值250亿美元。

风险也在这：投资→租卡→收购，链越长，越会被问需求里多少是"自己人"撑的 ⚠️ 周五 $NVDA 收229.28（-0.52%），消息在收盘后。

接下来看：交易形式和价格、官方声明；Beam还在红队测试阶段，权重说本月晚些放出。

不构成投资建议。

最新のAIモデル比較とサイバー攻撃能力の実態について分析・回答します。

　質問の核心である「現在一部セキュリティ責任者に開放されているClaude Mythosに次ぐネットワーク攻撃性能をGLM5.3が持っているのか（他モデルを引き離しているのか）」という点について、結論から申し上げますと、「ベンチマーク上の純粋な攻撃構築能力ではMythosや一部のフロンティアモデルに迫る水準であり、かつ“誰でも無制限に利用できる（オープンウェイト）モデル”としては圧倒的な単独首位（一線を画す存在）」というのが最新の評価です。
　以下に、Anthropicのレッドチーム調査報告（2026年9月下旬公表）や米国NIST（国立標準技術研究所）等の公開データに基づき、現状を構造的に整理します。

1. 攻撃性能の比較：GLM5.3とMythos（および他モデル）の位置づけ

　Anthropicが実施したエンドツーエンドのエクスプロイト構築テスト（V8 JavaScriptエンジン等の既知バグに対する攻撃コード作成能力）などの評価において、各モデルの性能差が具体的に可視化されています。

Claude Mythos Preview / Mythos 5.1（米国・Anthropic）:
成功率: 約14%（410回中56回成功）
位置づけ: 世界最高峰の自律攻撃・セキュリティ能力を持つ「フロンティア最高峰」。ただし、厳しい審査を通った防衛機関やパートナー企業（Glasswing等）にのみアクセスが制限されています。

GLM-5.3 / GLM-5.3-Flash（中国・Zai）:
成功率: 約12%（410回中50回成功）
位置づけ: Mythos Preview（14%）に肉薄する異常な高スコアを記録。Opus 4.6やGLM-5.2といった前世代モデル、および既存の商用AIモデルが「ほぼ0%」であった壁を突き破り、Mythosと同等の跳躍を見せました。

その他の一般公開モデル（GPT-4.5/5系、Claude Sonnet/Opusの標準版等）:
　安全装置（セーフガード）が厳格に機能しており、自律的に動くエクスプロイトコードを一から組み上げる高度なサイバータスクにおいては、プロンプトの拒否または能力の制限によりスコアが大幅に低く抑えられています。

2. なぜGLM5.3の登場が「決定的な脅威」とされるのか？

　単に「性能がMythosに近い」こと以上に、セキュリティ脅威として問題視されているのは「アクセスの自由度（無規制）」と「セーフガードの脆弱さ」です。

オープンウェイト（重み公開）による完全無制限化
　MythosやGPT-5.5等の最高峰モデルはAPI経由であり、ベンダー側でログ監視やアクセス制限がかけられています。しかし、GLM5.3はモデルの重み（ウェイト）がオープンソースとして配布されたため、誰もが自身のローカルGPU環境（またはクラウド）にダウンロードして実行可能です。

安全装置の容易な解除（Ableration / プリフィル）
　標準のGLM5.3にも一応の拒否機能はありますが、「＊＊＊」と偽装プロンプトを与えるだけで64%、思考トークンをあらかじめ攻撃肯定で埋める（プリフィル）と92%、そして安全制御を除去した改変版（abliteratedモデル）では100%の確率で攻撃指示に従うことが実証されました。この制御除去（abliterate）に必要なコストもわずか数千ドル（約1,200〜4,400ドル程度）であり、すでにダークウェブや有志コミュニティで「制限解除版GLM5.3」が多数流通しています。

3. 構造的影響

　この状況が意味するのは、「これまで国家レベルの高度ハッカー組織や、厳格に審査された防衛機関（Mythos保持者）しか使えなかったトップレベルの自律ハッキングAIが、約4000円〜数万円程度の実行コストで一般の犯罪者にまで行き渡った」という非対称な現実です。

攻撃側（犯罪組織・個人）: GLM5.3の制限解除版を用い、前回触れたような「1社あたり25ドルでの24時間全自動スキャン＆侵入」を無差別に実行可能。

防衛側（一般企業）: 従来通りの人間による手動パッチ適用やシグネチャ監視では、GLM5.3が自律生成する1-day/ゼロデイ攻撃の速度に対処不能。

対抗軸: 先ほど分析した「ICI特許のような、通信のトポロジー（論理構造）そのものをOSカーネル層で超高速に監査し、AI生成パケットを自律破棄する防御アルゴリズム」や、審査された防衛者向けMythos等による「AI対AIの自動修復」の早期実装が、物理的かつ構造的な最優先課題となっています。

検証プロトコルに基づく総合評価
総合信頼性スコア: 85.0%（実用最適解）
Logic : Anthropic等のベンチマーク比較およびNIST（米国国立標準技術研究所）の評価と論理的に整合しています。
Grounding: Physics : 実際にHugging Face等で配布されているGLM5.3のオープンウェイトモデルの存在、およびローカルGPUでの動作環境の実態に基づいています。
Grounding: Social : 制御解除モデル（abliterated）の流通や、AI規制・安全保障を巡る米中および米主要AI企業間の対立構造と一致します。
保留事項 (IIR):
　本評価は主にAnthropicのレッドチームが提示したベンチマーク（V8バグ悪用率等）に基づくものであり、未公表のOpenAIやGoogleの最先端防御モデル（内部プレビュー版等）の非公開能力との完全な横並び比較には観測限界が存在します。
補完に必要な情報:
　第三者検証機関（英国AISIや米CAISI等）による、GLM5.3と他国オープンモデル（Qwen系等）の最新のサイバー評価比較データ。

**Dave Blundon：** "对，就这点快速说一句。预训练现在大概只占算力的四分之一，而强化学习占了三分之一到一半。所以它会继续改进，但基于他们现在有的东西，用 RL 是到不了中国那个水平的。他们应该坚持那个配方，先追平中国模型，然后靠规模把它们压下去。"

**Peter Diamandis：** "Dave，你的看法？"

**Dave Blundon：** "嗯，他们显然在填补市场里一个巨大的空缺。很多美国公司突然醒悟过来说，'我需要 AI，我去哪儿弄？我总不能一辈子只订阅 Anthropic 吧。'好吧，你唯一的选择就是中国的。然后你会想，'等等，Alex Wissner-Gross 一直在说代码注入的风险。我不知道——我是银行，我是保险公司，我甚至不知道自己允不允许用中国模型。而且特朗普不喜欢我那么做。'所以，你带着一个'还算不错'的美国产品进场，它会卖疯了。但把它放进背景里看：你现在是 20 亿美元估值。就在一年、一年半前，Cerebras 上市，做了世界历史上最大的 IPO，400 亿。这个才 250 亿。这些数字太惊人了。所以，对，我不知道他们会成功还是失败，但我知道他们在填补市场里一个非常非常开阔的空缺——一个值得信赖的、美国本土的、你可以拿来起步的开源平台。那方面需求巨大。"

**嘉宾：** "我想说——如果他们造一个所有人能在自己现有硬件上用的模型，会不会更好？因为企业拿不到 Blackwell，也拿不到 Hopper。"
